default.description: Default capabilities for the main window. `core:webview:allow-create-webview-window` is scoped to `main` only — the child `network-viz` window inherits the more restrictive `network-viz` capability (see network-viz.json) and cannot spawn further windows. `core:window:allow-close` is similarly main-only: it lets the main window orchestrate the lifecycle of its child windows (used by the E2E suite to reset the viz between runs, and a natural fit for future 'close all visualizations' UX). Child windows cannot close each other or the main window.

network-viz.description: Capabilities for the network visualization child window. Intentionally omits `core:webview:allow-create-webview-window` (least privilege) — only the `main` window is allowed to spawn child windows.
